_comment: GMAIL_FETCH_EMAILS, captured from the live Composio v3 API and then
sanitised: the recipient address and Message-ID are substituted, and the
body is truncated. The STRUCTURE is untouched, because that is the only
part under test — field names, nesting, and the header array shape.
The one thing to preserve if you ever regenerate this: `messageId` at the
top level is Gmail's hex id, while the RFC822 Message-ID lives down in
payload.headers. Those two carrying the same name at different levels is
exactly the trap the mapping test guards.
